footprint.notes: Pfizer's 10-K gives only company-wide facility counts (251 properties; Pfizer Global Supply responsible for 37 plants, 'including in Belgium, Germany, India, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Singapore and the U.S.') and PP&E for the U.S. versus two international groups; the 10-K does not say which countries are Developed or Emerging Markets. No state or country breakdown of employees, investment or taxes was found: the 10-K gives only 'approximately 81,000 people worldwide', and the 2024 Impact Report Performance Data file has no headcount by geography. pfizer.com's U.S. Manufacturing Sites page (undated, read Nov 2026) says 11 manufacturing sites and 2 distribution centers and 'More than 10,000 U.S. colleagues dedicated to manufacturing and supply operations', with no per-site headcount; ten of its sites are listed here; Sanford North NC is left out because the page describes it as not yet operational ('Once operational, the Sanford North facility will have the capabilities for producing biologics'). Revenue by geography is in the records and not repeated.
